title: Docs lookup reply
description: GET /docs/lookup?q= reply: the read-only lookup over the pinned COSMOS docs in cache/cosmos-docs-7.2.1/ (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §8.1, §8.4, §16.5 U17). At most three results.

query.description: The q the lookup was given.

path.description: The page's path in the docs tree.

sha256.description: The page file's hash, as the fetch recorded it.

text.description: The page's text, cut at 4,000 characters.
